recognize_zh: 低倍下真皮膠原纖維間佈滿密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤，呈血管周圍與附屬器周圍分布並延伸到深層真皮；這種深而密的真皮淋巴浸潤是水痘樣淋巴增生性疾病（HV-LPD）與一般光敏性皮膚炎的差別線索，細胞形態需高倍確認。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate diffusely permeating the reticular dermis between collagen bundles
Accentuation around vessels and adnexal structures, including a cuff around a pale vacuolated adnexal structure at left center
Infiltrate extends deep into the dermis rather than being confined to the superficial perivascular plexus
Cells appear small to medium at this magnification; cytologic atypia cannot be assessed
No epidermis or ulcer included in the field
describe_en: Low-power sections of skin show a dense lymphoid infiltrate diffusely involving the reticular dermis, dissecting between collagen bundles with accentuation around vessels and adnexal structures. The infiltrate extends deep into the dermis. The infiltrating cells appear small to medium-sized, but cytologic atypia cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the setting of vesiculopapular lesions on sun-exposed skin and an EBER-positive cytotoxic T/NK-cell infiltrate, the findings are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: PMLE shows marked papillary dermal edema with a superficial and deep perivascular infiltrate of small reactive lymphocytes that are EBER-negative, without dense diffuse dermal permeation.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, involving skin
ddx.vs: Cutaneous ENKTL shows larger atypical cells with angiodestruction and extensive necrosis, typically in older patients without a photodistributed vesicular eruption.
These show interface change with mucin (lupus) or wedge-shaped infiltrates with eosinophils (bite), and the lymphocytes are EBER-negative.
